title: Team offsite next month
body:
Hi everyone,

Our November offsite is confirmed for November 20-21 in the Hudson Valley. We'll cover the 2027 roadmap, team retros, and some hiking.

Please RSVP by November 1 and note any dietary restrictions. Agenda is in Notion under "November Offsite - Hudson Valley".

See you there,
Abraham
